data.name: Evoshop_Quest_Intro
data.value: [tmp] Go rescue Eevee from Depleted Basin.[br][tmp] I mention that I want to get an Ice Stone and evolve into Glaceon.

data.name: Evoshop_Quest_Given
data.value: [tmp] I'm waiting for you to rescue Eevee from Depleted Basin.

data.name: Evoshop_Quest_Complete_Brother_1
data.value: [emote=Surprised][tmp] I speak, surprised, about how my sister changed so much.

data.name: Evoshop_Quest_Complete_Sister_1
data.value: [tmp] I mention that I had to use the Ice Stone to evolve and fend off wild Pokémon.[br][emote=Sad][tmp] I apologize for having used it.

data.name: Evoshop_Quest_Complete_Brother_2
data.value: [tmp] I say it's okay, and that it's better for you to have used it and survived.[br][tmp] I ask if you have any other evolution stones.[br][emote=Sad][tmp] I say that I don't want you to have to go back to Depleted Basin and risk your life to get me an Ice Stone.

data.name: Evoshop_Quest_Complete_Sister_2
data.value: [emote=Worried][tmp] I say that I have a few, including a Fire Stone.

data.name: Evoshop_Quest_Complete_Brother_3
data.value: [tmp] I ask you to give me the Fire Stone.

data.name: Evoshop_Quest_Complete_Brother_4
data.value: [tmp] I say that I am a Flareon now.

data.name: Evoshop_Quest_Complete_Brother_5
data.value: [tmp] I thank the player for having rescued my sister.[br][emote=Sad][tmp] I lament that we're now stuck as the wrong Eeveelutions.

data.name: Evoshop_Quest_Complete_Sister_3
data.value: [tmp] I propose that we find a way to prevent what happened to us from happening to other Pokémon.

data.name: Evoshop_Quest_Complete_Brother_6
data.value: [emote=Worried][tmp] I ask what she means.

data.name: Evoshop_Quest_Complete_Sister_4
data.value: [tmp] I say that we trade evolution items with other Pokémon so they get the ones they need.

data.name: Evoshop_Quest_Complete_Brother_7
data.value: [emote=Happy][tmp] I agree and say that the Evolution Swap Shop is now open for business.
